scope: Original DLW examples; conserved x-mass meshes; physical field error
density_weights: Fixed equal y averaging over physical band [-.75,.75], zero outside; same band under y refinement
boundary: Nonperiodic exact physical x endpoints and lower-y u base; top-y numerical perturbation quadratically extrapolated around the exact background, same SD/FD closure. No interior exact forcing.
initialization: Sample same continuous physical u,v; structural state derived from these same data. No exact interior reset or defect cancellation. Mesh initial coordinates from same density functional as evolution.
metrics: signed physical e_u and e_v on same evaluation coordinates
u and v max absolute error independently
relative max divided by fixed initial peak of each field
ratios against uniform SD, uniform FD and FD with same density
native-node errors and initial common-grid reconstruction error
control_policy: State disagreements compared at shared physical points; require dt-half disagreement <=5% of main exact error, evaluation change <=1%; x/y refinements reported separately rather than assumed negligible
stopping: Any nonpositive density/J or divergence is reported as failure, not hidden; shorten T identically if necessary
meaning: Measured exact-solution errors and refinement diagnostics. A rigorous nonlinear finite-time upper bound is not inferred from agreement of runs.
implemented_density: Literal r_sigma,j=1-(v_j+sigma*delta0 u_j)/4, with true corrected finite-h flux of each method, same F layers; not staggered aligned rplus
source_freeze: experiment.py sha256 stored with every run; changes require archiving previous runs, never silently mixing
boundary_review: Before interpreting first230 results, independent source analysis identified O(h) global v contamination from a fixed-zero ghost error. First230 preserved in before_y_boundary_review. Same quadratic perturbation closure applied to SD and FD, then entire comparison rerun; parameters, meshes, time, metrics unchanged.
